findings.title: RE-DERIVED is not a lattice status
findings.detail: Markers only recognise SEALED|CANDIDATE|REOPENED|OPEN. A section marked only RE-DERIVED inherits the previous SEALED container. Authors must always pair RE-DERIVED with CANDIDATE or SEALED explicitly (now done for C-2).
findings.requiredFix: Document in 00 status legend: RE-DERIVED is a history tag, not a status; must accompany SEALED/CANDIDATE/OPEN.
